description_en: Creates a resource group for a cluster
description_zh: 调用CreateDBResourceGroup接口为集群创建资源组
kebab_example: aliyun adb create-db-resource-group --db-cluster-id am-bp1ub9grke10000 --group-name TEST_GROUP --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in the destination region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.

The name can be up to 255 characters in length.

The name must start with a digit or an uppercase letter.

The name can contain digits, uppercase letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
长度不超过255个字符。
必须以数字或大写字母开头。
可包含数字、大写字母、中划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The query type. Valid values:

interactive (default): interactive query mode.

batch: batch query mode.

Job: offline job mode
parameters.help_zh:
查询类型，取值说明：
interactive（默认值）：交互查询模式。
batch：分批查询模式。
Job：离线查询模式
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en:
The minimum reserved computing resources, in ACU.

If the resource group type is Interactive, the minimum reserved computing resources are 16 ACU.

If the resource group type is Job, the minimum reserved computing resources are 0 ACU
parameters.help_zh:
最小计算预留资源，单位为ACU。
当资源组类型为Interactive时，计算预留资源最小为16 ACU。
当资源组类型为Job时，计算预留资源最小为0 ACU
parameters.name: min_compute_resource

parameters.help_en:
The maximum reserved computing resources, in ACU.

If the resource group type is Interactive, the maximum reserved computing resources are the current unallocated resources of the cluster. The step size is 16 ACU.

If the resource group type is Job, the maximum reserved computing resources are the current unallocated resources of the cluster. The step size is 8 ACU
parameters.help_zh:
最大计算预留资源，单位为ACU。
当资源组类型为Interactive时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为16 ACU。
当资源组类型为Job时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为8 ACU
parameters.name: max_compute_resource

parameters.help_en: The resource specifications of a single cluster, in ACU
parameters.name: cluster_size_resource

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of clusters that must run in the resource group. The minimum value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 资源组内至少需要运行的Cluster个数，最小为1
parameters.name: min_cluster_count

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of clusters that can run in the resource group. The maximum value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 资源组内最多可以运行的Cluster个数，最大为10
parameters.name: max_cluster_count

parameters.help_en:
The mode of the resource group. Valid values:

Disable (default): regular mode.

AutoScale: auto-scaling mode
parameters.help_zh:
资源组模式，取值：

Disable（默认）：常规模式。
AutoScale：自动弹性模式
parameters.name: cluster_mode

parameters.help_en:
The engine of the resource group. Valid values:

AnalyticDB (default): the AnalyticDB for MySQL engine.

SparkWarehouse: the SparkWarehouse engine
parameters.help_zh:
资源组引擎，取值：

AnalyticDB（默认）：AnalyticDB for MySQL引擎。
SparkWarehouse：SparkWarehouse引擎
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The configuration parameters for the Spark application. These parameters apply to all Spark jobs that are executed in the resource group. To configure parameters for a specific Spark job, set the parameters in the code when you submit the job
parameters.help_zh: Spark应用配置参数，应用于该资源组执行的所有Spark作业。如需为某个Spark作业单独配置参数，可以在提交作业时通过代码设置
parameters.name: engine_params

parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes. The default value is 0.

The resources of one node are 16 cores and 64 GB.

The number of nodes cannot be too large. The value must meet the following condition: Number of nodes × (16 cores and 64 GB) ≤ Remaining available resources of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
节点数量，默认值为0。
1个节点的资源量为16核64 GB。
节点数量不能过大，需满足节点数量*16核64 GB小于等于集群剩余可用资源
parameters.name: node_num

parameters.help_en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value to make sure that it is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一。大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token
